label: Galaxea R1 Lite arm (A1X)
license: no license stated in the public guide
platforms: any (roslibpy over WebSocket); rosbridge_server runs on the robot network
realtime: none on this host: the robot's controller runs the loop
note: Needs Galaxea's HDAS driver and the mobiman joint tracker running, plus rosbridge_server. The public guide documents ROS 1 topics; pass ros2=true for a ROS 2 robot, which was not checked against Galaxea documentation. Joint limits are the published A1X ranges.
